lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Ga2Sb2 (reduced formula Mg6GaSb) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga and Sb centers each coordinated by 10 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have 13 geometric neighbors (1 Ga, 2 Mg, 1 Sb). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and face-sharing between Mg 13-vertex polyhedra and Ga 10-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Mg 13-vertex polyhedra.
